She is cheerful and always smiles.
My uncle is generous and helps many people.
The staff was helpful at the hotel.

She is very intelligent and learns quickly.
I feel nervous before a test.

sections.title: Useful Patterns
sections.subtitle: Describe personality and explain your reason

items.usage: Use be verb + adjective: "I am reliable" / "She is cheerful."
examples: I am helpful and reliable at work.
My friend is cheerful and easygoing.
My coworker is intelligent, serious, and reliable.

items.usage: Use because to explain why a personality trait matters.
examples: I like friends who are honest because I can trust them.
I am reliable because I always finish my tasks on time.
Being sociable is useful because it helps people communicate.

items.usage: Use "more of a/an + adjective + person" for a natural comparison.
examples: I am more of an easygoing person.
I am more serious at work than at home.

items.question: How would you describe your personality?
answers: I am helpful to my friends and cheerful with my family.
At work, I am serious and reliable because I finish my tasks on time.

items.question: What personality traits do you like in friends?
answers: I like friends who are reliable, easygoing, and honest.
I like reliable friends because I can trust them.

items.question: Are you more sociable or serious?
answers: I am more serious at work, but I can be easygoing with friends.
I am not very sociable, but I like going out with close friends.

items.question: When do you usually feel nervous?
answers: I usually feel nervous during a test or before an interview.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.line: Hey David, have you met the new employee, Kevin?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.line: Yes, I talked to him yesterday. He seems very intelligent and polite.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.line: I agree. I also think he is very sociable. During lunch, he talked with everyone in the office.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.line: It is good to have someone friendly on the team.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.line: Do you think he will work well with us?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.line: I think so. He seems reliable and hardworking. He said he likes helping coworkers.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.line: That is great. A helpful colleague makes a big difference.

paragraphs.text: People have many different personalities, and these personalities affect how they work with others.
In a workplace, personality can influence communication, teamwork, and productivity.
Reliable employees are valuable because other people can trust them to finish their work on time.
In a successful workplace, it is important to respect different personalities and learn how to work together.

comprehension.question: How can sociable people help the workplace?
comprehension.answer: They can help create a friendly work environment.

comprehension.question: Why are reliable employees important?
comprehension.answer: Other people can trust them to finish work on time.

comprehension.question: What personality traits are good for leaders?
comprehension.answer: Brave, confident, honest, and generous traits are useful for leaders.

comprehension.question: What problems can nervous or selfish employees cause?
comprehension.answer: They may avoid speaking in meetings or focus only on their own success.

items.question: Fix this sentence: I am more easygoing person.
items.hint: Try: I am more of an...

items.detail: Say "I am more of an easygoing person," not "I am more easygoing person."
items.chinese: person 是單數可數名詞，要有冠詞。

items.detail: Say "Being too serious is boring," not "too much serious is boring."
items.chinese: 形容詞當主詞時，可用 being + adjective。

items.detail: Say "I am good at software engineering," not "intelligent with software engineering."
items.chinese: 描述擅長領域時用 good at。
